method: Each finding names a published claim, the check performed, the result and the source. CONFIRMED means it reproduces; CORRECTED means it did not and the correction is published; FLAG means it is not wrong but it is ambiguous or unsupported and needs a human decision. Nothing here blocks anything.

findings.claim: The 32-club standings table transcribed by the canonical hub is correct through Week 10.
findings.check: all 32 clubs compared field by field (W, L, T, PF, PA) against the official standings page, re-read this session

findings.claim: No verified results feed existed, so backtests were impossible.
findings.check: recompute every club's W/L/T/PF/PA/games from the game log and compare with the official standings
findings.detail: The claim was true when written and is now false: the feed exists and 192/192 fields agree. The flags that said otherwise are superseded here, not deleted.

findings.claim: Pythagorean wins, luck residuals and the most fortunate / most unlucky tables are computed from official PF and PA.
findings.check: recompute g*PF^2.37/(PF^2.37+PA^2.37) for all 10 clubs named in the two tables from the official standings
findings.detail: Largest disagreement 0.005 wins, which is rounding. Sample size 10 of 10 clubs correct.

findings.claim: r(game total, |margin|) = -0.161, read as 'same-game total and blowout size move together'.
findings.check: recompute both r(total, |margin|) and r(total, signed margin) on the 137 finals
findings.detail: r(total, |margin|) = -0.0157 and r(total, signed margin) = -0.1607. The published figure is the signed version under a mislabelled column, so the label and the reading attached to it were both wrong. The pipeline was fine. Both versions are now published side by side.

findings.claim: Eight club-level coefficients computed from the official standings.
findings.check: recompute each coefficient independently from the official PF/PA table
findings.detail: All coefficients reproduce to within 0.002, which is the precision of the published rounding. Example: net points per game vs win pct is published as 0.8781 and recomputes to 0.8794.

findings.claim: 31 club depth charts captured, 26 undated, Houston publishes an image only.
findings.check: count the charts in each of the two captures this repository holds
findings.detail: The hub's numbers come from tools/nfl_data.py: 31 charts, 26 undated, Houston absent. The desk capture in data/desk/depth.json tells a different story: 31 charts with parseable slots (30 undated), and Houston PRESENT but with zero parseable rows. Both files are internally correct and they are different captures, so neither page is wrong - but a reader comparing them will see two different counts for the same week. Label the capture source on both pages, or consolidate to one capture, before either count is quoted in a decision.
findings.source: https://www.nfl.com/injuries/league/2026/reg10 and each club's own depth-chart page

findings.claim: G-2 requires >= 300 settled bets and >= 3 seasons per strategy.
findings.check: exact binomial power calculation against the -110 breakeven, verified against enumeration by tools/selftest_stats.py
findings.detail: 300 bets only reaches 80% power for a true edge of about 59.6%. At the 55% edge the gate is written for, the requirement is about 2,272 settled bets. The published threshold would have admitted strategies that are statistically indistinguishable from luck.

findings.claim: Injury status weights and positional cost figures drive the originated lines.
findings.check: searched the repository for any derivation, regression or citation for these numbers
findings.detail: No derivation exists. The positional costs and status weights are priors with no measured basis, and they move lines by up to 6.5 points on the Week-10 slate. They are correctly labelled as parameters on the site, but a reader may not realise the largest single adjustment to the board is an opinion. Published as Q-08 and Q-14.

findings.claim: The model applies zero home-field advantage, contrary to the usual 2.5-3 points.
findings.check: measure mean home margin over the non-neutral finals and attach an interval
findings.detail: Measured 0.469 points on n=130, 95% interval -1.812 to 2.751. The interval includes zero, so using zero is defensible on this sample. It is a genuinely surprising result and deserves the flag it already carries.

findings.claim: No licensed price feed exists; market columns are blank.
findings.check: every market cell in the hub board and every cell in the new snapshot store inspected programmatically
findings.detail: Every market cell in both places is blank. No page asserts a price. The third-party prices in x3lab are present and correctly excluded from official claims.

findings.claim: The desk model reports walk-forward MAE 10.52 with r 0.20 on 121 games.
findings.check: run an independent walk-forward with the rules stated in tools/verified_feed.py and compare
findings.detail: This session's walk-forward, with the parameters fixed and printed, gives MAE 9.29 and r 0.3082 on 89 games - better than the published figure on a smaller sample, using a different rating definition. Both can be right. The discrepancy is a difference in method, not an error, but two published MAE values for the same model on the same season is exactly the kind of drift this review exists to surface. One definition should be adopted before either is quoted.

findings.claim: The deployed site builds from its data and has no broken internal links.
findings.check: rebuild the canonical hub from data with no edits and diff the result; then parse every page and resolve every reference
findings.detail: tools/x3_engine.py and tools/build_hub.py reproduce the committed pages byte for byte. 26 pages parse here with every internal reference resolving, and the repository's existing link auditors all pass.

findings.claim: The Week-10 Munich game is played at 'Alemun & Munchen / Munich (NFL International Game)'.
findings.where: hub/data/lines.json (neutral_site field, NE@DET), surfaced on hub/lines.html
findings.check: read the official game page for Patriots at Lions and the Week-10 schedule page for the location and stadium
findings.detail: The official game page prints LOCATION: MUNICH and STADIUM: FC BAYERN MUNICH STADIUM. The Week-10 schedule page prints only 'International Game / Munich'. No official page contains the string 'Alemun & Munchen', which reads like an unverified placeholder that was carried forward. The venue does not affect any number on this site, and this session's own pages record only the structural neutral-site flag, but the string is printed on the canonical lines page and should be corrected there by its owner. Independently raised by another session as C-11.

findings.claim: A moneyline can be derived from the model spread and is published on the board.
findings.check: convert each price back to an implied probability and require the two sides to sum to 1.000, since the model carries no margin
findings.detail: The first build of this module priced the away side by negating the home price, producing -158/+63 and an implied sum of 1.226 - a 22% margin the model does not have. Each side is now priced from its own probability, which gives the fair -158/+158. A permanent gate in tools/verify_desk.py asserts the implied sum on every row and a negative control confirms the gate fires.
